messages:
marta: Heads-up — opened PR that touches the on-prem sidecar token flow + VPC route table for east-coast dedicated region.

marta: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4872

marta: Main change: switch sidecar to use vault-transit proxy for token wrapping, remove shared file credential approach. Also adds a small routing rule update so sidecar traffic routes via 10.200.0.0/16 to the secrets proxy in the VPC.

anj: Thanks. Looping sec review. main concern is ensuring no creds leak to workloads during startup. did you add MFA header enforcement?

marta: added a 2nd layer: sidecar will enforce metadata-only reads until token unwrap completes. code snippet:
```
# startup sequence
read_metadata()
establish_tls()
call_vault_transit_unwrap(token)
mount_kv()
```

tyler: CI is red on the integration tests — failing because the routing change needs a mock route in the dev harness. I'll patch the harness.

infra-qa-bot: infra-qa: integration tests failed on platform-e2e (route-sim mismatch). See CI: https://ci.redwood/12345

olivia: privacy: can you confirm telemetry? We need minimal telemetry for privacy customers — no token ids in logs, only success/fail and sanitized host.

marta: olivia — yes, scrubbed token ids and set logging to low in on-prem builds. config flag: <LOG_SCRUB_LEVEL=STRICT>

anj: I can do a CR pass tonight. need 1 more security approval (sec-team) & privacy signoff before merge window Tue 09:00 UTC.

tyler: I'll take perf smoke tomorrow morning (latency delta), aim to confirm <+2ms median>.

olivia: privacy ack pending final doc update. I'll update the privacy matrix by EOD.

marta: Thanks — requesting @sec-team for formal LGTM. if no blockers, planning to merge in Tue slot.

sec-team: sec-team: quick note — add egress allowlist for svc account, and include KMS key ARN in PR description.

marta: added KMS ARN and egress allowlist. pinging again for review.

anj: left small nit re: retry backoff values. otherwise LGTM from sec perspective once egress is explicit.

marta: noted, will fix now. Thanks all :raised_hands:

tyler: CI green after harness patch. perf smoke looks OK, +1. 

olivia: privacy updated matrix and confirmed no PII leakage.

sec-team: sec-team: formal LGTM. merge in Tue window.

marta: merging Tue 09:00 UTC unless anyone yells. If you'd like a canary, I can stage canary in low-traffic cluster.

anj: canary please.

marta: will do. scheduling canary + rollback job.

infra-qa-bot: infra-qa: scheduled canary job id 8842 for Tue 09:15 UTC.

marta: thanks, closing loop.
